variants.name: Actor_ClearOwnedResourcesFromA0
variants.behavior: Clears the resource pointer at actor +0x2A, the VRAM/resource base at +0x2E, and each owned-resource occupancy byte counted by actor +0x29; restores D0 and FP before returning.

variants.name: Actor_ClearOwnedResourcesFromA2
variants.behavior: The equivalent A2-register variant used by linked collision-cleanup paths.

boundary_basis: The A0 variant begins after Actor_ClearOwnedResources and ends at its direct RTS immediately before the A2 variant.
Both bodies have identical resource-clear logic with only the actor base register changed.
